name: User Signed In
description: Fires when a user successfully authenticates with company ID and credentials.

name: User Sign In Failed
description: Fires when a login attempt fails due to invalid credentials or server error.

name: User Signed Out
description: Fires when a user explicitly logs out or is redirected due to token expiry.

name: Payment Batch Created
description: Fires when an accountant creates a new driver payment batch.

name: Payment Batch Posted
description: Fires when a payment batch is posted and locked for processing.

name: Payment Batch Completed
description: Fires when a payment batch is marked complete and statements are set to PAID.

name: EFT File Generated
description: Fires when an EFT (CPA 005) file is generated from a posted batch.

name: Credit Card CSV Uploaded
description: Fires when a credit card transaction CSV file is successfully parsed and previewed.

name: Credit Card Transactions Imported
description: Fires when parsed credit card transactions are confirmed and imported into the system.

name: Airport Trips CSV Uploaded
description: Fires when an airport trips CSV file is uploaded and ready for import.

name: Mileage CSV Uploaded
description: Fires when a mileage data CSV file is uploaded and ready for import.

name: Financial Statement Generated
description: Fires when a driver or owner financial statement is successfully generated.

name: Invoice Generated
description: Fires when an invoice is generated for an account customer.

name: Payment Recorded
description: Fires when a payment is recorded against a customer account.

name: Driver Created
description: Fires when a new driver is added to the fleet.

name: Driver Updated
description: Fires when an existing driver's profile is modified.

name: Statement Recalled
description: Fires when a driver statement is recalled from a payment batch.

name: Data Export Downloaded
description: Fires when a user exports driver or financial data to CSV or PDF.

name: Error Encountered
description: Fires when a critical operation fails with an unrecoverable error.
